arguments.sql_query:
WITH trd AS (
  SELECT person_id, MIN(condition_start_date) AS trd_date
  FROM omop.condition_occurrence
  WHERE condition_concept_id IN (
    SELECT descendant_concept_id FROM omop.concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 607540
    UNION SELECT 607540
  )
  GROUP BY person_id
), ket_concepts AS (
  SELECT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id FROM omop.concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (785649,1366610)
  UNION SELECT 785649 UNION SELECT 1366610
), ect_concepts AS (
  SELECT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id FROM omop.concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (4030840,4111663,605263,605264,4336318,4332436,4210144,4210145)
  UNION SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept WHERE domain_id='Procedure' AND LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%electroconvulsive therapy%'
), events AS (
  SELECT t.person_id, 'ketamine-based' AS escalation, d.drug_exposure_start_date AS event_date, d.visit_occurrence_id
  FROM trd t JOIN omop.drug_exposure d ON d.person_id=t.person_id
  WHERE d.drug_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM ket_concepts)
    AND d.drug_exposure_start_date >= t.trd_date
  UNION ALL
  SELECT t.person_id, 'ECT' AS escalation, p.procedure_date AS event_date, p.visit_occurrence_id
  FROM trd t JOIN omop.procedure_occurrence p ON p.person_id=t.person_id
  WHERE p.procedure_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM ect_concepts)
    AND p.procedure_date >= t.trd_date
), first_event AS (
  SELECT person_id, escalation, event_date, visit_occurrence_id,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY person_id ORDER BY event_date) AS rn
  FROM events
), index_events AS (
  SELECT fe.person_id, fe.escalation, fe.event_date,
         COALESCE(v.visit_end_date, fe.event_date) AS followup_start,
         fe.visit_occurrence_id AS index_visit_occurrence_id
  FROM first_event fe
  LEFT JOIN omop.visit_occurrence v ON v.visit_occurrence_id=fe.visit_occurrence_id
  WHERE fe.rn=1
), psych_readmit AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT i.person_id
  FROM index_events i
  JOIN omop.visit_occurrence v ON v.person_id=i.person_id
  WHERE v.visit_concept_id IN (9201,262)
    AND v.visit_start_date > i.followup_start
    AND v.visit_start_date <= DATEADD(day,90,i.followup_start)
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
      JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id=co.condition_concept_id
      WHERE co.visit_occurrence_id=v.visit_occurrence_id
        AND (LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%depress%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%bipolar%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%psych%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%suicid%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%anxiety%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%mood disorder%')
    )
)
SELECT i.escalation,
       COUNT(*) AS n_patients,
       SUM(CASE WHEN pr.person_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_90d_psych_readmit,
       CAST(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN pr.person_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL(6,2)) AS pct_90d_psych_readmit
FROM index_events i
LEFT JOIN psych_readmit pr ON pr.person_id=i.person_id
GROUP BY i.escalation
ORDER BY pct_90d_psych_readmit;

Nominally, **ECT** had the lower 90-day psychiatric readmission proportion in the queried TRD EHR cohort:

| Escalation | n | 90-day psych readmissions | Proportion |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| ECT | 1 | 0 | 0.0% |
| Ketamine/esketamine | 2 | 1 | 50.0% |

**Interpretation:** In this dataset, ECT “wins” numerically, but the sample is far too small to make a reliable comparative-effectiveness claim.

Mechanistically, the result is biologically plausible because **ECT** produces broad, durable frontolimbic network effects: induced therapeutic seizures modulate **monoaminergic**, **GABA/glutamate**, HPA-axis, and inflammatory signaling; increase **BDNF/neuroplasticity**; and alter activity/connectivity in **prefrontal–cingulate–limbic circuits** implicated in severe depression. Ketamine-based therapy acts rapidly via **NMDA receptor antagonism**, AMPA throughput, glutamate burst signaling, and **mTOR/BDNF synaptogenesis** in prefrontal–limbic circuits, but its antidepressant effect can be more transient without maintenance dosing.
